_comment: SimLingo baseline numbers. This file ships EMPTY on purpose.
Fill it from one of two provenances and record which in 'source':
(a) the SimLingo paper's published table for the SAME benchmark suite,
route set and weather presets you evaluate our agent on, or
(b) your own SimLingo reproduction run on your hardware.
Mixing suites (e.g. baseline on Bench2Drive, ours on Town05 Long) makes the
delta column meaningless. Delete keys you do not have -- the report prints
'--' for a missing metric rather than inventing one.
source: UNSET -- fill in: paper table N / own reproduction, commit, date
notes: state here the suite, route file, weather presets and repetition count
